That is a direct coordination and preparedness failure.","question_ids":["8B.5"]},{"title":"Two more Russian officials arrested in widening military corruption probe","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"2024-05-23","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/two-more-russian-officials-arrested-in-widening-military-corruption-probe-3454644","summary":"More arrests inside the defence apparatus show internal discipline, but also that corruption still penetrated a core spending-heavy ministry.","question_ids":["8B.5","8B.4"]},{"title":"Russia detains former deputy defence minister for suspected fraud","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"2024-08-29","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/russia-opens-fraud-case-against-former-deputy-defence-minister-3592856","summary":"A former deputy defence minister was detained for suspected fraud, reinforcing that the control system remained leaky even at the top of the defence hierarchy.","question_ids":["8B.5"]},{"title":"Putin lets economically significant entities limit information disclosures","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-01-29","url":"https://uk.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/putin-lets-economically-significant-entities-limit-information-disclosures-3315001","summary":"Reducing disclosure weakens external scrutiny and the feedback loops needed for disciplined execution across state-linked firms.","question_ids":["8B.5","8B.4"]},{"title":"Russia prepares for further tax rises due to war","publisher":"Ukrinform / Reuters","date":"2024-11-02","url":"https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/3922326-russia-prepares-for-further-tax-rises-due-to-war-reuters.html","summary":"Reuters reporting said war financing was forcing tax rises and cuts in small-business support and education development. That shows follow-through, but one heavily warped toward war priorities.","question_ids":["8B.5","8B.3"]},{"title":"Russia: Nations in Transit 2024","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/russia/nations-transit/2024","summary":"Freedom House says regional governments stayed aligned with the Kremlin and Putin directed the cabinet to improve municipal finances, but it also says municipalities lacked financial independence and decisions were made by a small closed circle.
